uzo.purpose: Takes one line of text from a person: a name, an address, an e-mail, a search term.

instead.kialo: A text that runs over several lines needs a field that grows with it, because one line hides what was written; Fundamento has no such Ero yet.
Choosing one of several values is a selection, not an entry, because a field would take any text and a list shows what can be chosen; Fundamento has no such Ero yet.

A setting that stays on or off needs a control that shows its state, because a text would have to be read to know it; Fundamento covers it with sxaltilo when the setting applies at once (in a form, applied with it: markobutono).

boundary.kialo: A password field hides what one types and needs a switch to show it, because a hidden text is an own behaviour, not a kind.
A number with step buttons is a control of its own, because the buttons change the value and the field only shows it.
A date is typed in a format or picked from a calendar, because people write dates differently; which way a product takes is a decision of a person, and Fundamento has no such Ero yet.
A file is chosen, not typed, because the value is not text; Fundamento has no such Ero yet, so a person decides.
A field without a visible label cannot be found again once the placeholder is gone, because the placeholder disappears while typing.
A prefix or a suffix (currency, unit, icon) comes in a later round, because it changes the inline room of the field; until then an icon stands next to the field, not in it.

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A field without a form has no sender, because the entry is only sent with the form.

containers.name: dialog
containers.kialo: A dialog may demand an entry before it ends, because the decision it ends in may need a value.

containers.name: search-bar
containers.kialo: A search is one field with its button, because the term is the whole entry.

with.kialo: Fields of one form stand stacked, because a person reads a form top down and fills it in that order.
The form ends with the button that sends it, because filling it in does nothing by itself; the button stands after the last field, not beside it (a search excepted).

never.kialo: A field stands in no slot of a button, because a button is one target with one name and the field could not be reached on its own.
